metadata.description: Lady of the Haladin, second chieftain of the House of Haleth. Daughter of Haldad and twin sister of Haldar. After her father and brother were slain by Orcs, she led her people from Estolad to Brethil. She refused the love of Caranthir and maintained the independence of her people. She died childless and was succeeded by her nephew Haldan, son of Haldar.
